text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The URA Finale comes to a close as a great success, and what's more…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: <chrname>'s presence greatly enlivened the racecourse, leaving Director Akikawa immensely satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: <chrname>'s presence greatly enlivened the racecourse, filling the crowd with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Director Akikawa then prepares a meal for me to celebrate the success of the URA Finale.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There, she presents me with her fan, as well as a deluge of compliments.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I place the fan carefully in my pocket and vow alongside <chrname> that I won't betray Director Akikawa's passion!
